newsitem.title: UK: UK govt shares anxiety over stg rate - Liddell.
newsitem.headline: UK govt shares anxiety over stg rate - Liddell.

text.p: Britain's government wants a stable and competitive pound and is anxious about its current high level, Helen Liddell, economic secretary to the Treasury, said on Wednesday.
"The government shares the anxieties that there are about the level of the exchange rate, but there are no short-term fixes," she told parliament during a debate on sterling.
"There is a need for a stable and competitive exchange rate, consistent with the government's objective of price stability.
"That's one of the main reasons why we are committed to creating an environment of macroeconomic stability," Liddell said.

"Low inflation and sound public finances are necessary conditions for sustained exchange rate stability, and (are) sensible objectives in their own right for the management of the economy," she added.
